label: partition-year
sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW a
PARTITIONED BY (year(id1))
AS SELECT id as id1, id as id2 FROM range(1,2)

label: partition-multipart
sql: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW a PARTITIONED BY (a.b) AS SELECT 1
